description: Land Title Settlement Dept - T.R Kirulapana , Thimbirigasyaya D/S/D, Colombo District (25-14-204-000527)
categorisation: The gazette content is exclusively concerned with the formal registration and declaration of land titles for specific parcels of land, including owner details, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. It is published under the "Registration of Title Act" and falls under "PART III - LANDS." This fits the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4), which covers land registrations, title determinations, and property ownership matters. There is no government structural/personnel change (Types 1-3) or focus on other specialized categories like legal frameworks (beyond the procedural use of the Act), commercial, electoral, public service, or judicial matters.
